name: Rabbis
overview: The title 'Rabbi' was commonly used in Jesus' day to address Jewish teachers and leaders, as seen in Matthew 23 where the scribes and Pharisees are described as sitting in Moses' seat and being greeted as 'Rabbi' in the marketplaces. However, Jesus instructs His followers not to be called 'Rabbi,' emphasizing that there is only one Master—Christ—and that all believers are brothers. This teaching highlights the unique authority of Christ over religious titles and the equal standing of believers before Him. Additionally, the term 'Master' is used in the Gospels to address Jesus, underscoring His role as the ultimate teacher and leader.
